github.role: Issues, pull requests, branches, commits and code review
github.scope: global; prefer the gh CLI when it already covers the operation
github.activation: when operating on remote GitHub data
github.setup_note: Requires GitHub authentication configured in the agent; never store tokens in project files.

azure-devops.role: Work items, sprints, builds, repos and test plans
azure-devops.scope: qa-dotnet or browser-extension projects with Azure DevOps access
azure-devops.activation: when reading/updating Azure Boards; prefer the official remote server with OAuth

playwright.activation: only for tasks that need a real browser

chrome-devtools.role: Performance, console, network, traces and visual issues

context7.activation: when an external dependency has an uncertain API

ghidra-mcp.role: Decompilation, symbols, xrefs and renaming through Ghidra
ghidra-mcp.activation: only on owned or authorized binaries; broader alternative: https://github.com/bethington/ghidra-mcp

x64dbg-mcp.role: Dynamic debugging of Windows executables through an x64dbg plugin
x64dbg-mcp.activation: when static analysis is insufficient; never against third-party software without authorization

apktool-mcp.role: Decode, inspect and rebuild APKs through Apktool

rea.role: Multi-target reverse engineering (native, managed, Electron/JS, firmware, web) with evidence
rea.activation: when the task needs evidence from a shipped artifact; prefer plain CLI tools when sufficient

mcp-reverse.role: Process/memory inspection for game modding and reverse engineering
mcp-reverse.activation: never on online games, anti-cheat-protected titles or third-party software without authorization
